decisions.text: type pie: fractions of the total are the message: a pie, which shows ½, ⅓ and ¼ at a glance and announces the whole (G1.36)
slices largest first, clockwise from 12 o'clock: Car or taxi, Walk, Bus (school or public), Cycle
“Train and other (scooter, skateboard, etc.)” and “No answer” last, whatever their size, in their reserved greys (G2.1, G4.15, G7.28)

each slice its own colour, handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): Car or taxi series-1, Walk series-2, Bus (school or public) series-3, Cycle series-4, Train and other (scooter, skateboard, etc.) all-others, No answer missing
each slice named outside it, its percentage of the total under the name, formatted as one set (G7.27, D-51 (ii)): 35%, 27%, 18%, 7%, 8%, 4%
leaders to Train and other (scooter, skateboard, etc.), No answer (a zero, a slice under 8°, or a label moved from its place; G7.29, D-34)
no outlines: true gaps 1.0 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)
